name: tablekit
description: Drop-in React data and pivot grids backed by TanStack, plus a framework-free pivot engine.

scripts.build: pnpm inject:version && pnpm build:main && pnpm build:subpaths
scripts.test:e2e: cd e2e && pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:ui: cd e2e && pnpm exec playwright test --ui --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm examples:build && pnpm examples:hosting:test && pnpm check:package-artifacts
scripts.pack:react: pnpm build:react && pnpm build:react:subpaths && pnpm -F @lynellf/tablekit-react pack --dry-run
scripts.pack:pivot: pnpm build:pivot && pnpm build:pivot:subpaths && pnpm -F @lynellf/tablekit-pivot pack --dry-run
scripts.release:react: pnpm build:react && pnpm build:react:subpaths && pnpm -F @lynellf/tablekit-react publish --access public
scripts.release:pivot: pnpm build:pivot && pnpm build:pivot:subpaths && pnpm -F @lynellf/tablekit-pivot publish --access public
